title: Evaluation of Prognosis and Prognostic Scores in Geriatric Patients With Acute Pancreatitis
brief_summary:
* To compare the prognosis of acute pancreatitis between geriatric and other adult patients
* To evaluate the efficacy of various prognostic scores in geriatric patients with acute pancreatitis
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Acute pancreatitis Hospitalisation Adult patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recurrent pancreatitis
* Chronic pancreatitis
* Outpatient follow up
* Loss of follow up within 3 months of discharge
